items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.

Arrived at response location; a female vagrant was sleeping in front of BNZ premises. Woke her and asked her to politely move away, but due to her heavy belongings she was very tired and could not carry them, so we decided it best to support her to her destination.
Successfully took the female individual's belongings to her destination, all clear (photo on file). Continuing patrols.
Standing by in front of 77 Convenience Store Queen Street before continuing patrols.
